                      TEXTPACK REQUEST TASKS

         ID    ITEM

         a     Print Document
         b     Display Print Queue or Cancel Print Job
         c     Change Printing Order
         d     Display Index of Diskette Contents
         e     Continue Printing With Element Now On Printer
         f     Request Printer
         g     Release Printer
         h     Start Printer








Type ID letter to choose ITEM; press ENTER:
